v = int(input())
seq = [0] * 17
seq[0] = 1
for i in range(1, 17):
    seq[i] = seq[i - 1] * 10 + 1

def solve(index, val):
    val = abs(val)
    if index == 0:
        return int(val)
    base = int(val // seq[index])
    next_base = base + 1
    costA = base * (index + 1) + solve(index - 1, val - base * seq[index])
    costB = next_base * (index + 1) + solve(index - 1, val - next_base * seq[index])
    return min(costA, costB)

print(solve(16, v))
